arguments.sql:
SELECT s.id, s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate, s.totalSetSize,
       COUNT(st.id) AS translation_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS distinct_languages,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT st.language) AS languages
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.type = 'commander'
  AND s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY s.id, s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate, s.totalSetSize
ORDER BY s.totalSetSize DESC, s.id ASC
